an3.153:2.1: sucinā kāyakammena, sucinā vacīkammena, sucinā manokammena. Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito vyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ ca puññaṃ pasavatī ti.
